ee:transform.doc:name: Prepare Smart Read Status GET Ensek API Request

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java --- p('ensek.smartreadstatus.uri') replace "{ensekAccountId}" with attributes.uriParams.'ensekAccountId' replace "{meterpointReferenceNumber}" with attributes.uriParams.'meterpointReferenceNumber'

flow-ref.doc:name: Call Common SigV4 Auth Code Sub Flow
flow-ref.name: utility-sub-flow-ensek-aws-sigv4-auth-code

http:request.doc:name: Call Ensek Smart Read Status Get API
http:request.http:headers: #[output application/java --- { "X-Amz-Date" : vars.xAmzDate ++ "", "Authorization" : vars.authStringSigv4, "Host" : p('ensek.endpoint.host'), "Content-Type" : "application/json", "traceparent": vars.OTEL_TRACE_CONTEXT.traceparent as String default '', "tracestate": vars.OTEL_TRACE_CONTEXT.tracestate as String default '' }]

logger.doc:name: Log Debug Response
logger.message: Response payload get supply status : #[{"smartReadStatus": payload.Status}]
